name: Michael Stone
source:
Mike Stone has been [url=/c176650]John[/url]'s best friend since kindergarten. He can be incredibly annoying, but when the chips are down he will have John's back no matter what. It is safe to say that John would trust him with his life and vice versa. Once back from the war, Mike set John up with a job and an office in his father's building. It was a pretty sweet deal, but to John, it felt a little like a handout. If the roles were reversed though, John would do the same for him, which lessened the feeling of guilt a little bit. Mike is annoying, intelligent, and a man-whore.

[Edited from in-game description]
